overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong and highly professional social media presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, focusing primarily on computational social science, disinformation, and coordinated inauthentic behavior. Across a total follower base of 3,580, his posts receive remarkably high engagement, showing that his academic and professional audience is highly responsive to research outputs, job opportunities, and software tool updates.

contentThemes.description: Research findings, tools (like CooRnet), and academic conferences focusing on detecting coordinated campaigns and disinformation.
Announcements regarding open postdoctoral positions and research opportunities for PhD students in computational fields.
Celebration of newly awarded research grants and official publication announcements of peer-reviewed papers.

recommendations: Leverage Bluesky's high engagement rate by posting more interactive discussions and thread-based summaries of new research papers.
On LinkedIn, encourage team members to tag themselves and share hiring posts to further amplify reach beyond the core follower base.
On Mastodon, incorporate academic and technical hashtags (e.g., #CSS, #Disinformation) to increase discoverability within the federated network.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky is the most engaging platform with an average engagement rate of 6.14%. Content regarding new papers and student opportunities performs exceptionally well here.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon shows steady engagement (4.55% average ER) for highly technical announcements like software updates (CooRnet v2.0), indicating an audience of peers and developers.
platformInsights.linkedin: LinkedIn has the largest follower base (1,850) and generates the highest absolute engagement. It is highly effective for professional announcements, grants, and recruitment posts.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
New research opportunity for PhD students interested in computational social science. Reply for details!
Excited to announce that our research team has been awarded a new grant to study information operations across social media platforms.
